tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: Logo navy, exact from the logo file. The brand's anchor colour: fills, the Navy theme ground. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-gold
tokens.usage: Logo gold, exact from the logo file (the "in"). 5.6:1 on white, so it works as text at any size on light grounds. Only 2.6:1 on navy: never use it on navy, use `gold` instead.

tokens.name: brand-grey
tokens.usage: Logo grey, exact from the logo file (BUSINESS SERVICES). Reference only; use `ink-muted` in layouts.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Post ground. Daylight = white for everyday advisory posts; Navy = logo navy for premium, seasonal and announcement posts.

tokens.name: surface-mist
tokens.usage: The cool wash behind hero imagery and the fade at the top of the canvas. Replaces the ad-hoc light-blue gradients.

tokens.name: surface-deep
tokens.usage: Solid navy panels: fact chips, closing slide.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers, the swipe-cue outline. Decorative only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy, lead-ins, pointers. 14.3:1 on surface, 12.5:1 on surface-mist (daylight); 13.1:1 on navy surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: website, swipe cue, labels. Daylight value is the logo grey: 6.3:1 on surface, 5.5:1 on surface-mist. Navy: 7.0:1 / 5.7:1.

tokens.name: headline
tokens.usage: The heavy-caps keyword (BUSINESS, LAUNCH). Logo navy on Daylight.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Secondary emphasis word only, sparingly. A lighter step of the logo navy's hue, so it never clashes with the mark. 5.9:1 on white; 7.2:1 on navy.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The one gold word per post. Daylight = logo gold (5.6:1 on white, 4.9:1 on mist). Navy = lifted gold, 7.1:1 on navy surface. The old ochre (#d9a441, 2.3:1 on white) is retired.

tokens.name: gold-leaf
tokens.usage: Decorative fills only: the pointer triangle, rules, cover blocks. Not for text on light grounds (2.8:1).

tokens.name: tag
tokens.usage: Key tag fill (BUSINESS SETUP). Logo navy on Daylight; flips to gold on Navy so it doesn't disappear into the ground.

tokens.name: on-tag
tokens.usage: Text on a tag fill. 14.3:1 daylight, 7.1:1 navy.

tokens.name: on-deep
tokens.usage: Text on surface-deep panels. 13:1+.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Warning marks only: the X on a mistake, a deadline. Always next to a word. 5.4:1 on white, 5.9:1 on navy.

families.arabic: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "Geeza Pro", Tahoma, sans-serif

groups.name: Post headlines
groups.note: Sizes are pixels on the 1080 x 1350 post canvas. One family, two voices: light italic for the lead-in, heavy caps for the keyword.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Listicle and count posts only. One per post.

styles.name: keyword
styles.usage: The one word the post is about. Uppercase, 1 to 2 words, color headline or gold.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Title-case headline when the phrase is too long for keyword caps.

styles.name: lead-in
styles.usage: The soft half of the headline, above or below the keyword. Always italic 300, never bold.

groups.name: Post text
groups.note: Nothing on the canvas is smaller than caption (24px). At feed size that is ~9pt, the practical floor on a phone.

styles.name: pointer
styles.usage: The supporting line with the gold triangle marker. Max 2 lines.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Improper liquidation can freeze your accounts for years.
styles.usage: Carousel slide copy. Max 40 words per slide.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Footer band: website and swipe cue, ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Base unit on the 1080 canvas.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between lead-in and keyword.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Column gutter; tag inner vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between headline stack and tag or pointer.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between headline block and body; tag inner horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between content zones.

tokens.name: margin
tokens.usage: Outer safe margin on all four sides. Covers the ~34px side crop of the 3:4 profile-grid thumbnail.

tokens.name: header-band
tokens.usage: Top band holding the logo (260px wide, top 72px). Top-right of this band stays EMPTY: Instagram's carousel icon sits there. Headline zone starts at 272px.

tokens.name: footer-band
tokens.usage: Bottom band: website left, swipe cue right.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Key tag and fact chip. Matches the current BUSINESS SETUP tag.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Image panels and navy fact panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Swipe cue and step dots only.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: The only shadow: under a hero cut-out subject or a floating tag. Never on text.
